title: secret-template values
description: The published interface of this chart: the name of one Secret, the keys it carries, and nothing that could put a value in it. Helm checks these values on lint, template and install, so a caller learns about a wrong shape when it renders rather than when a pod fails to start.

name.description: The Secret's name. Required, because a Secret with no name is an object nothing can reference; a lower-case DNS subdomain, because that is what the API server accepts.

keys.description: The key names the workload looks for. At least one, because a Secret with the right name and no keys fails at pod start; distinct, because a repeated key renders once and hides the copy. Every item is a name and only a name - this array is the whole of what a caller may say about the Secret's contents.

type.description: The Secret's type. Every value this chart writes is the empty string, so a type demanding populated keys is accepted here and rejected by the API server; Opaque is the type that matches what this chart renders.

labels.description: Extra labels on the Secret, for an environment's own tooling. Label values are strings, and a number or a boolean written here reaches the API server as the wrong type.
